list.title: Ship notices
list.label: Deliveries you announced
list.searchHint: Notice, your reference or DDT, tracking, our order
list.failed: We could not read your ship notices.
list.failedBody: Nothing is lost: try again in a moment.
list.emptyBody: Announce a delivery from a confirmed order: your packing list is checked against the order before the goods leave.
list.capped: Only your latest 500 ship notices are shown: search to find an older one.

held.preview: An office preview only reads: it never announces a delivery for the supplier.
held.mayWrite: Your access lets you read your deliveries, not announce them: ask your admin for the right to upload.
held.offline: No connection: try again when you are back online.
held.noLine: Pick at least one line to ship.
held.fixLines: A line needs a fix: see the line in red.
held.fixTerms: A field needs a fix: see the field in red.
held.sent: This ship notice was sent already.
held.send: Some things still hold the send: see the list above.
held.closed: This ship notice no longer changes.
held.sheetNotKept: Keep the list you read, or choose another file first.
held.unreadable: Some rows could not be read: fix them in your file and upload it again.

announce.title: Announce a delivery
announce.failed: We could not read this delivery.
announce.stale: This ship notice changed elsewhere while you were typing.

notice.title: Ship notice {number}
notice.failed: We could not read this ship notice.
notice.missing: This ship notice is not here
notice.missingBody: It was discarded, or it belongs to another organisation.
notice.differences_one: Received with differences: {count} line differs from what you announced.
notice.differences_other: Received with differences: {count} lines differ from what you announced.
notice.received: Received by our warehouse on {at}, as announced.
notice.inTransit: In transit: our warehouse expects it.
notice.editable: You can still change it until our warehouse receives it.

pick.title: Which order do you ship from?
pick.hint: The orders confirmed with lines still to deliver. One ship notice is one order.
pick.emptyBody: Confirm an order first: its lines then show here.

lines.title: What you ship
lines.hint: The open lines of {order}, each in full: change a quantity to ship part of it, or untick a line that is not in this delivery.
lines.emptyBody: {order} has no open line left to deliver.
lines.over: More than is still open: the check will say “Not as ordered”.
lines.dyeBatchHint: The order asks one dye batch.
lines.staysOpen: Not in this delivery: the line stays open.

asks.crVi: Cr VI test report with each lot

packing.title: Leather packing list
packing.hint: Upload your own packing list (CSV or Excel), one row per hide. Each hide is checked against the order before anything is kept.
packing.dropHint: CSV or Excel, up to 700 KB: hide number, area, unit, order line, grade, thickness, dye batch.
packing.noLeather: No leather on this delivery: there is no packing list per hide. Go on to the transport.
packing.unreadable_one: {count} row of {file} could not be read.
packing.unreadable_other: {count} rows of {file} could not be read.
packing.fixAndUpload: Fix them in your file and upload it again: nothing was kept.
packing.counts: {ok} OK · {check} to check · {bad} not as ordered.
packing.notKept: Nothing is kept until you press Keep.
packing.differences: Something not as ordered can still be sent with a note: we decide at receipt.
packing.none: No list per hide? Go on: we measure every hide when it arrives (the check says so).

transport.title: Transport and papers
transport.ddtTravels: The DDT travels with the goods.
transport.refHint: Your own reference for this delivery.
transport.noteHint: For our dock: what to know when it arrives.

problem.ddtDate: A DDT date goes with its number.
problem.order: The goods arrive on or after the day they leave.

review.noList: No list per hide: we measure every hide when it arrives.
review.documents_one: {count} document we ask for with deliveries is not on file yet: send it with the goods.
review.documents_other: {count} documents we ask for with deliveries are not on file yet: send them with the goods.
review.notAsOrdered: Some of it is not as ordered.
review.notAsOrderedBody: You can still send it: say why in a note for our dock, and we decide at receipt. Or go back and fix the list.
review.changing: Each step saves as you go: our warehouse sees the changes at once.

send.noLines: Add at least one line to ship.
send.noShipDate: Give the day the goods leave.
send.noExpected: Give the day the goods arrive: our dock plans by it.
send.documents_one: {count} document our company requires with a delivery is missing: ask us in the order's messages.
send.documents_other: {count} documents our company requires with a delivery are missing: ask us in the order's messages.
send.needNote: Say why in a note for our dock.

done.title: Delivery announced
done.next1: Our warehouse sees it on its board of arrivals.
done.next2: You can still change it until it is received.

cancel.title: Cancel this ship notice?
cancel.subject: {notice} · order {order}
cancel.dock: Our warehouse no longer expects this delivery.
cancel.again: To ship it later, announce the delivery again.
cancel.whatDraft: The draft and its packing list are removed.

held.reason: Say why the delivery is cancelled: our dock reads it.

reason.NO_GRADE: No grade given: the order asks {asked}.
reason.NO_THICKNESS: No thickness given: the order asks {min}–{max} mm.
reason.DYE_BATCH: Dye batch {batch}: the line ships dye batch {main} and the order asks one dye batch.
reason.NO_DYE_BATCH: No dye batch given: the order asks one dye batch.
reason.DYE_BATCHES: {count} dye batches ({batches}): the order asks one dye batch.
reason.EARLIER_DYE_BATCH: Dye batch {batch}: earlier deliveries of this line came in {earlier}, and the order asks one dye batch.
reason.OVER_ORDER: {shipping} {uom} with {before} {uom} already received or on its way: more than the {expected} {uom} ordered (up to {upTo} with its {pct} % tolerance).
reason.LIST_VS_LINE: The hides add up to {total} {uom}; the line says {quantity} {uom}.
reason.NO_PACKING_LIST: No packing list per hide: we measure every hide when it arrives.
reason.CR_VI: This leather needs Cr VI evidence: no valid test report is on file.
reason.unknown: A check we cannot word here: ask us in the order's messages.

sheetRow.hideNumber: The hide number is missing or longer than 60 characters.
sheetRow.area: The area is not a number above 0.
sheetRow.unit: The unit is not m², dm² or ft².
sheetRow.lineNeeded: Name the order line (10, 20 …): this delivery has more than one leather line.
sheetRow.lineUnknown: Order line {line} is not a leather line of this delivery.
sheetRow.thickness: The thickness is not a number from 0 to the limit, two decimals.
sheetRow.grade: The grade is longer than 60 characters.
sheetRow.dyeBatch: The dye batch is longer than 60 characters.
sheetRow.note: The note is longer than 500 characters.
sheetRow.unreadable: This row could not be read.

issue.shipDate: Check the day the goods leave.
issue.expectedDate: Check the day the goods arrive: it is needed, on or after the day they leave.
issue.ddtDate: A DDT date goes with its number.
issue.parcels: Packages: a whole number from 1 to 9999.
issue.note: Something is not as ordered: say why in a note for our dock, or fix the list.
issue.reason: Say why the delivery is cancelled.
issue.lineGone: A line is no longer open on the order: read the order again.
issue.lineEnded: The buyer ended a line of this delivery: take it off.
issue.lines: Check the lines: at least one, each with a quantity above 0.
issue.headers: We could not find the columns of a packing list: use the template's column names.
issue.file: The file is empty, too large or not a CSV or Excel file.
issue.rows: Some rows need a fix: see each row.
issue.other: Something in it needs a fix.

problem.changed: Someone changed this ship notice meanwhile: read it again, then try once more.
problem.invalid: It was not accepted as it is.
problem.forbidden: Your access does not allow this: ask your admin.
problem.missing: This ship notice or its order is no longer here.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries in a short time: wait a minute.
problem.unavailable: We could not reach the server: try again.
problem.internal: Something went wrong on our side: try again.
problem.notShippable: That order has no confirmed lines to ship now: pick an order below.

unsaved.notice: Your delivery is not announced yet.
unsaved.change: Your change to the ship notice is not saved.
